criteria.criterion: Given the report page, When it is opened, Then the health section contains a paragraph reading exactly `Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days`
criteria.evidence: Test 'the health section contains the changed-since-prior-sprint paragraph' locates a paragraph inside #health with the text 'Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days' and asserts its full text equals that exact string. Test passes.

criteria.criterion: Given the report page, When it is opened, Then that paragraph comes after the `Status: All clear` paragraph, inside the health section, and before the Current Sprint section
criteria.evidence: Proven by two tests together: (1) 'the health summary is the first section' asserts main > section .first() has id 'health', meaning the health section precedes all other sections in main, including Current Sprint; (2) 'the changed paragraph follows the status paragraph inside the health section' asserts #health p nth(0) is 'Status: All clear' and nth(1) is 'Changed: Cycle time improved by 2 days', proving correct order within the health section. Both tests pass.
